entries.title: Narrator: "Upon our arrival to Castle Reinhart..."
entries.dialogueText: Upon our arrival to Castle Reinhart, we were greeted by the expressionless faces of the Palesian delegation with no sight of the Duke himself.

entries.dialogueText: Our convoy drove steadily across the cobbled streets of Old Town Pales. It was my second visit to the Palesian capital since becoming King of Rizia, and the atmosphere this time was far more tense.
